description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing ten‑tier hyper‑layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::HYPERFRAME-KAPPA

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-KAPPA-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK1
    TIER::LOWER

  [HYPER-KAPPA-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK2
    TIER::MIDLOW

  [HYPER-KAPPA-3]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK3
    TIER::MIDMID

  [HYPER-KAPPA-4]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK4
    TIER::MIDHIGH

  [HYPER-KAPPA-5]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK5
    TIER::UPPER

  [HYPER-KAPPA-6]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK6
    TIER::APEX

  [HYPER-KAPPA-7]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK7
    TIER::CROWN

  [HYPER-KAPPA-8]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK8
    TIER::SUMMIT

  [HYPER-KAPPA-9]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK9
    TIER::PINNACLE

  [HYPER-KAPPA-10]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HK10
    TIER::ZENITH

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    HYPERKAPPASET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    HYPERKAPPASET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-HYPERFRAME-KAPPA}
  HK10-HJ9-HI8-HH7

<END-HYPERFRAME-KAPPA>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑kappa block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
